evals.name: off-palette-link
evals.prompt: the 'Crie o seu negocio' link at the bottom of our login page is bright blue and sticks out horribly - the whole app is warm greens. it's running at http://localhost:5173/login. can you sort it out? we've got a token layer at src/frontend/src/shared/styles/tokens.css
evals.expected_output: A before/after comparison image showing the link themed from the token layer, contrast measured, and no source files edited before the user approves.

evals.name: dark-mode-diagnosis
evals.prompt: something feels off about dark mode on our login screen but i can't put my finger on what. app's at http://localhost:5173/login and the theme preference is stored in localStorage under 'marcacoes.theme'. have a look and tell me what you'd change
evals.expected_output: Dark mode actually captured (not light shot twice), a diagnosis with measured values, and a preview of the proposed change.

evals.name: mobile-layout-break
evals.prompt: on my phone the login form looks broken - the forgot password link ends up sitting right on top of the password box. http://localhost:5173/login. can you show me a fix?
evals.expected_output: A mobile-viewport before/after showing the label row fixed, produced without editing source first.
